name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
body: I want to be upfront: I'm based in Arvada, Colorado, Mountain time, not the East Coast you're hiring for right now. If that's a hard requirement, I understand completely. If there's any flexibility, here's why I think I'm still worth a look.

I don't have localization or TMS experience, and I want to say that plainly rather than dance around it. What I do have is 15+ years owning the client-facing side of complex, configuration-heavy platforms. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month while leading a team of onboarding specialists, at Birdeye I managed 15 to 20 partner accounts end to end with 94% retention, and at Accelo I built sequenced implementation plans and worked directly with engineering on API integrations. At Solenzo I now build and document the CRM and automation workflows I run for clients myself, and I've spent the last two-plus years applying AI tooling to make those processes faster, which lines up with where this role is headed.

The localization domain would be new to me, but the operational muscle, owning a client relationship end to end, documenting process, coordinating across engineering and vendors, isn't. If the location works, I'd welcome the conversation.
